visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey tailored suit, vest, and trousers, walks confidently down a bright hallway. She wears dark sunglasses and has her hands tucked into her blazer pockets. The setting features large floor-to-ceiling windows with an urban view and exposed industrial ceilings with track lighting. (2) The camera tracks her movement in a medium shot, highlighting her professional attire and the natural daylight of the corridor. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) A quick cut reveals a clothing rack filled with diverse garments on hangers in a studio environment. The camera pans slightly across the rack. (4) The scene shifts to the same woman squatting on the floor in a causal white t-shirt, light denim overalls, and a green baseball cap. She is using scissors to work on a black polka-dot dress hanging on a lower rack. Her facial expression appears focused and tired as she looks toward the camera.
